text: St Mirren celebrate with the Scottish League Cup in 2013
In 2013, the Scottish League Cup was celebrated by St Mirren.
Not too long ago, an underestimated St Mirren team defeated Celtic in a semi-final and then went on to beat Hearts at Hampden, clinching the 2013 League Cup.

St Mirren, competing in the Scottish Premiership, played to a goalless draw against League 1 champions Arbroath away from home and forfeited the bonus point after being defeated in the penalty shootout of the Premier Sports Cup.
It wasn't all that long ago that an unfancied St Mirren side overcame Celtic in a semi-final, then Hearts at Hampden, to win the 2013 League Cup.

But, first, Stephen Robinson's Buddies face a tricky opener on Saturday away to likely buoyant League 1 champions Arbroath as third-tier Annan Athletic host League 2 side Forfar Athletic looking for likely consolation points.

Before anything else, Stephen Robinson's Buddies will encounter a challenging start on Saturday as they travel to face the potentially spirited League 1 champions, Arbroath. Meanwhile, third-tier Annan Athletic will be playing host to League 2's Forfar Athletic, aiming to secure what could be invaluable consolation points.
On Saturday, Stephen Robinson's side start their competitive campaign away to Arbroath in the Scottish League Cup group stage (15:00).
Stephen Robinson's side start their competitive season away to Arbroath in the Scottish League Cup on Saturday (15:00).
Academy product Robinson was able to find a moment and make the difference as he dinked the ball through for Cameron Archer to chase and smash home.
